headline: Island Fronts Shift; Attrition Grinds On
war_summary: Since the last edition the map has seen fresh turnover on two northern sectors: Oarbreaker recorded two captures around Fort Fogwood in the past two hours, and Stlican Shelf logged two flips at Fort Hoarfrost and The South Wind during the same window. Farranac Coast, Godcrofts and Fishermans Row each added several ownership changes in the last six hours, pushing their day‑totals to fifteen, fifteen and eleven respectively, while Dead Lands has gone quiet after a burst of three flips earlier. The high‑casualty corridors — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — continue to bleed on both sides with accelerating losses but no further strategic‑base moves. The overall disposition still favors Colonials on the western and southern arcs and Wardens to the north and east.
